hypothesis: MWCC might color the later object into r30 and the saved event into r31 if the object and state are declared before an explicit saved-event alias, or if an eliminated object initialization or register storage-class raises the object's allocation priority.
canonical_compiler: GC/1.3 -O4,p with scheduling enabled (the generated build command contains no -schedule off option)

experiments.variant: predeclare object and state before saved_event; call all helpers through saved_event
initialize object to null before saved_event assignment, allowing dead-store elimination
explicit register storage class on the predeclared object

disposition: Hypothesis rejected. All tested allocation-priority variants collapse to the prior code. The clearest reconstruction was restored unchanged.
